title: Python Matplotlib Charts
description: Learn to create Bars, Histograms, and Pie Charts in Matplotlib.
example:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.bar(x, y)
plt.hist(data)
plt.pie(y)

challenges.title: Bar Chart
challenges.exercise: Plot a bar chart for x=['A', 'B'], y=[10, 20]. Print 'Bar Done'.
challenges.solution:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.bar(['A', 'B'], [10, 20])
print("Bar Done")
